  "description": "Working location: Hai Thanh CFS warehouse - Hai Thanh industrial zone - Pham Van Dong street - Hai Thanh ward - Duong Kinh district – Hai Phong (no shuttle bus service).\nWorking schedule: 8:00 - 17:00 on Monday - Friday & 08:00 - 12:00 on Saturday.\nRESSPONSIBILITIES:\n- Coordinate daily operations and resources to ensure plans are executed effectively.\n- Monitor inbound, outbound, inventory, and productivity to meet customer and internal KPIs.\n- Supervise staff and provide necessary training to ensure compliance with SOPs and work instructions.\n- Handle and resolve issues related to physical operations and system transactions.\n- Support new projects by setting up processes and standardizing procedures.\n- Propose and implement improvement initiatives for better operational efficiency.\n- Review non-conformities and recommend corrective actions.\n- Maintain and update training materials and conduct regular training for operators.\n- Oversee operator/DC staff performance to ensure adherence to standards.\n- Update work instructions and processes per customer or operational requirements.\n- Achieve customer KPIs, departmental KPIs, and support business targets.\n\nAddress and Time work\nLocation\n- Hải Phòng: Phường Hải An (Phường Hải An thuộc quận Hải An cũ) - Phạm vi làm việc trên toàn khu vực trên.\nWork Schedule\n- Thứ 2 - Thứ 6 (từ 08:00 đến 17:00)\n- Thứ 7 (từ 08:00 đến 12:00)",
  "requirements_text": "Requirements:\n2 năm kinh nghiệm chuyên môn  2 năm kinh nghiệm quản lý  Đại Học trở lên\n\nCandidate Requirements\nEducation: Bachelor’s Degree\nExperience:\n- Education: from college in related field.\n- Experience: 2-3 years of experience in warehouse operations (bonded WH is one plus).\n- Experienced in working with warehouse operating systems such as WMS, TMS, etc.\n- Location: prefer candidate who lives in Hai Phong or candidate willing to relocate to near the warehouses.\n- Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).\n- Good English communication skills (written and verbal).\n- Flexible, team-oriented, and able to communicate across all levels.\n\nKiến thức ngành\nLogistic / Vận tải, Kho vận, Xuất nhập khẩu / Hải quan\nKỹ năng cần có\nQuản Lý Kho, Kiểm Soát Chất Lượng, Quản Lý Nhân Viên, Quản Lý Kho Hàng, Giải quyết vấn đề, Hệ thống kho bãi, Kiểm Soát Hàng Tồn Kho, An Toàn Kho, Lập Kế Hoạch Và Phân Bổ Công Việc, đại học\nKỹ năng nên có\nQuản Lý Kho Hàng, Kiến Thức Về Logistics, Quản Lý Kho Vận, An Toàn Kho Hàng"
